column1: # baseline: 9c120a78 (scalar estimate_bits with serialized fast_log2f dep chain)
# harness: cargo run --release -p jxl-encoder --features profile-phases --example lossless_cliff_profile
# CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 7950X (Zen 4), AVX2 + AVX-512 capable
# Note: benchmarks ran WITHOUT -C target-cpu=native (runtime dispatch only)
# Full asm dumps (2K+ lines each) are NOT committed per project size policy.
# Wall-clock speedup is dominated by compute_best_tree reduction (the only
# Why it wins (vs the reverted Feb-17 nlog2n lookup + the reverted branchless
# bucket-shift sweep, see Phase-C in the commit message):
# 1. Old scalar inner loop (find_best_split asm @ baseline 9c120a78, line 1336+):
#          test edi, edi             ; mispredicts when zero/nonzero
#          cvtsi2sd xmm2, rdi         ; serial f64 conversion
#          ... fast_log2f scalar (shufps+divss on 4 SSE lanes for 1 result)
#          subsd xmm0, xmm3           ; SERIAL accumulator dep chain
#          vcvtdq2ps ymm3, ymmword ptr [rdi + 4*rsi - 32]  ; 8 i32→f32 in parallel
#          vcvtdq2ps ymm15, ymmword ptr [rdi + 4*rsi]       ; another 8 (2× unroll)
#          vfmadd213ps ymm9, ymm4, ymm12                    ; 8 FMA polynomial
#          vdivps ymm4, ymm9, ymm13                         ; 8 polynomial dives
#          vmulps ymm3, ymm4, ymm3                          ; 8 c * log2(p)
#          vsubps ymm0, ymm0, ymm3                          ; ymm0 dep chain runs in parallel with ymm2
# 16 contributions per loop body (8 lanes × 2 accumulators) → ~8-10× ILP.
# fast_log2f's ~15-cycle latency is hidden in the SIMD pipeline.
